title: Documented Hardship and a Longer Charged-Off Settlement Plan Term
content:
## Clause

For a Charged-Off Settlement Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, a request for medical hardship or death of a household earner with a medical bill or a death certificate recorded on it adds 2 installments; a request for job loss or divorce or separation with a termination notice or a divorce decree recorded on it adds 1 installment; any other request adds none. A document counts when it is recorded on the request as a document received.

## Condition matrix

| Hardship reason on the request | Documents recorded on the request | Installments added |
|---|---|---|
| medical hardship or death of a household earner | a medical bill or a death certificate | 2 |
| job loss or divorce or separation | a termination notice or a divorce decree | 1 |
| reduced income or other | any | none |
| medical hardship or death of a household earner | only a termination notice or a divorce decree | none |
| job loss or divorce or separation | only a medical bill or a death certificate | none |
| any reason | none recorded | none |
